properties.description: Eight real-binary tests, isolated HOME: the walk of every client mode (--remote over a real --http server, --shared over its daemon, a pointer-attached client over a registry) — write refused by the client, read answered, store unchanged; the refusal's shape and the file rule; the latent surface starting no design and serving a later one read-only; --shared --read-only with no store starting nothing; a call holding "initialize" not taken for a handshake; and a recording stand-in proving nothing refused reaches the server, an unreadable tool list refuses even a read, and a plain client forwards everything.
properties.name: every_client_mode_honours_read_only.rs — --read-only against every client mode, over real servers and a recording stand-in
